scope: One adapter-authored AC1027 TABLECONTENT block content with two ordered ATTDEF attributes, emitted and read back through ASCII and binary DXF.

admission.blockRecord: One uniquely named and source-bound BLOCK_RECORD with one matching BLOCK.
admission.identity: Each ATTDEF handle resolves uniquely to an entity in the referenced block, has that BLOCK_RECORD as owner, and was emitted exactly once without ambiguity. Duplicate target handles are rejected.

physicalOutput.handleProof: Physical group 340 and both group-330 values are compared with the identities recovered by fresh typed readback.

controls: Absent ATTDEF target refusal preserves the sentinel destination.
Wrong ATTDEF owner refusal preserves the sentinel destination.
Repeated ATTDEF target refusal preserves the sentinel destination.
failureAndRetry.retry: The same adapter exports successfully after each source graph is repaired.

typedReadback: The block content handle equals the emitted BLOCK_RECORD owner. Both ordered attributes retain their emitted ATTDEF handles, owner, content ordinal, one-based index, and exact text.

validation.focusedOutput: Generated DATALINK writer and adapter routes: PASS

limitations: The writer currently admits at most two attributes on this block-content profile. Three or more attributes, arbitrary index permutations, multiple block contents, and mixed scalar/block content lists remain refused or unqualified.
The receipt establishes authored field transport and this library's readback, not native CAD rendering or source-file semantic parity.
